query: SELECT o.id, o.orderNo, o.orderStatus, o.paymentStatus, o.subtotalHkd, o.platformFeeHkd, o.sellerReceivableHkd, o.paymentMethod, o.createdAt, o.updatedAt, l.title FROM marketplaceOrders o LEFT JOIN marketplaceListings l ON o.listingId = l.id WHERE o.sellerReceivableHkd = 9.50 OR o.subtotalHkd = 9.50 OR o.platformFeeHkd = 0.50 ORDER BY o.createdAt DESC LIMIT 10;
